attributes.action: Vote for General Election, giving ALL UK Citizens a fair choice of who they want
attributes.additional_details:
A lot of things recently have been going on and many people are fed up with what’s going on around them. Yes there is SOME good but there is also ALOT of negative impact that is affecting our great country!

Many I have spoken to have agreed with this. I know theres people that will still vote for Labour but I can almost guarantee that if we are allowed to re-vote, there will be more people that chose other parties, as Labour have let a lot of their own voters down. Our country NEEDS better!
attributes.background: All UK Citizens should have a chance to express how they feel by giving everyone the choice in re-voting who they’d prefer to run our country. Labour (not only Starmer) have left citizens of the UK, loss of hope & faith in what they believe is right for this country. It’s only fair to re-vote again!

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
